meta.name: Template Composition Rules
meta.description: Guidelines and constraints for AI-driven template composition

tier_1.name: Recipe Mode (Strict)
tier_1.ai_behavior: Execute recipe, fill placeholders, no improvisation

tier_2.name: Selection Mode (Guided)
tier_2.description: Select and arrange components based on content analysis
tier_2.ai_behavior: Analyze content, select matching components, arrange logically

tier_3.name: Composition Mode (Creative)
tier_3.description: Create templates with creative freedom within constraints
use_for: Type 3: Content built from scratch or AI-written
tier_3.ai_behavior: Interpret brief, compose from components, follow rules

must_have.rule: Every page must start with a hero/header section
Every page must include at least one CTA
Use only components from the library
must_have.rationale: Ensures BEM compliance and brand consistency

forbidden.rule: Do not create custom HTML unless extending framework
Do not use non-BEM CSS classes
Do not skip security checks (ABSPATH, escaping)

visual_rhythm.description: Alternate content density and visual weight

max_consecutive_text.rationale: Prevent reader fatigue, add visual breaks

section_spacing.ai_action: Use correct namespace, spacing is automatic

decision_tree.if: Content is sequential steps or timeline
Content is list of items or features
decision_tree.then: Use list pattern (lcms-list with appropriate modifier)

decision_tree.if: Content is call-to-action or conversion point

decision_tree.then: Use column partial with text content type

component_selection_guidance.when_uncertain: Choose simpler component, can always enhance later

when_to_extend: Guided patterns don't fit the use case
bem_framework_extension.documentation_requirement: Document new component for library promotion
bem_framework_extension.validation: AI should flag for human review

material_design_integration.approach: Wrap Material components in BEM containers

validation_checks: All components exist in library or are properly extended

casing_rules.PascalCase: For class names (not commonly used in templates)

type_1_structured.process: Load recipe → Validate data → Fill placeholders → Generate PHP

type_2_supplied.process: Analyze content → Select components → Arrange logically → Generate PHP

type_3_creative.process: Interpret brief → Compose from components → Validate rules → Generate PHP

security.escaping: Use esc_html(), esc_url(), etc. for dynamic content
